pli-tv-pvr2.10:1.3: avassutā bhikkhunī avassutassa purisapuggalassa adhakkhakaṃ ubbhajānumaṇḍalaṃ gahaṇaṃ sādiyati āpatti pārājikassa,
pli-tv-pvr2.10:1.4: bhikkhu kāyena kayaṃ āmasati āp. saṃghādisesassa,
pli-tv-pvr2.10:1.8: kāyasaṃsaggaṃ sādiyanapaccayā imā pañca āpattiyo āpajjati. ||1||
pli-tv-pvr2.10:2.3: bhikkhunī jānaṃ pārājikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicchādeti āp. pārājikassa,
pli-tv-pvr2.10:3.3: ukkhittānuvattikā bhikkhunī yāv. sam. na paṭinissajjati ñattiyā dukkaṭaṃ
pli-tv-pvr2.10:3.6: bhedakānuvattikā bhikkhunī yāv. sam. na paṭinissajjati āp. saṃghādisesassa,
pli-tv-pvr2.10:3.7: pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā yāv. sam. na paṭinissajjati āp. pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-pvr2.10:3.8: yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsanāya na paṭinissajjanapaccayā imā pañca āpattiyo āpajjati. ||3||
pli-tv-pvr2.10:8.1: samaggena saṃghena ukkhittaṃ bhikkhuniṃ dhammena vinayena satthu sāsanena anapaloketvā kārakasaṃghaṃ anaññāya gaṇassa chandaṃ osāraṇapaccayā tisso . . . ||4||
pli-tv-pvr2.10:9.1: avassutā bhikkhunī avassutassa purisapuggalassa hatthato khādaniyaṃ vā bhojaniyaṃ vā sahatthā paṭiggahetvā bhuñjanapaccayā tisso āp. āp.,
pli-tv-pvr2.10:10.1: kin te ayye eso purisapuggalo . . . bhuñja vā 'ti uyyojanapaccayā tisso . . . ||6||
pli-tv-pvr2.10:11.1: kupitā bhikkhunī yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsanāya na paṭinissajjanapaccayā tisso . . . ||7||
pli-tv-pvr2.10:12.1: kismiñcid eva adhikaraṇe paccākatā bhikkhunī yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsanāya na paṭinissajjanapaccayā tisso . . . ||8||
pli-tv-pvr2.10:13.1: saṃsaṭṭhā bhikkhunī yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsanāya na paṭinissajjanapaccayā tisso . . . ||9||
pli-tv-pvr2.10:14.1: saṃsaṭṭhā 'va ayye tumhe viharatha mā tumhe nānā viharitthā 'ti uyyojentī yāv. sam. na paṭinissajjanapaccayā tisso . . . ||10||
pli-tv-pvr2.10:17.5: dadhiṃ viññāpetvā bhuñjanapaccayā imā dve āpattiyo āpajjati. ||8||
